entities.summary: Tash Sultana (b. 1995-06-15, Melbourne) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Melbourne and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
